description: What the main window's Interface, loaded from the app itself, may call: the two Core bridge commands, showing the window and quitting (FLOW-CLOSE-AND-QUIT), listening for the Shell's quit-requested event and the webview's drag-and-drop events, which carry the paths dropped on the composer (FLOW-SEND-MESSAGE-R08), and the dialog plugin's open, which picks a folder to add a project (FLOW-NEW-SESSION-R27), and opening a web or email link from the agent's words in the system's handler (FLOW-READ-TRANSCRIPT-R03). Nothing else, and no remote origin.
